name: BLOODWORK CIRCUIT: Shelf Combat Underground
description: One of the oldest continuous underground combat operations in GLMZ, BLOODWORK CIRCUIT runs unsanctioned full-contact fights in Shelf basement venues, condemned infrastructure, and rotating popup locations announced through encrypted mesh networks. Unlike more structured underground leagues, BLOODWORK has no weight classes, no round limits, and no prohibition on improvised weapons introduced after the first minute of a match. Medical staff are present at every event — not for liability reasons, but because the organizers discovered years ago that visible medical preparation increases ticket sales.
story_hooks: A runner is hired to deliver a package to a BLOODWORK venue and witnesses something that makes her realize the medical staff are not there to help the fighters.
A Tier 3 social worker trying to document Shelf living conditions becomes the Circuit's most unexpected regular spectator — and begins to understand why.

A BLOODWORK fighter who has won forty-three consecutive matches is quietly approached by a corporate talent scout offering a legal career — and the Circuit's organizers do not intend to let their asset walk.
